hero.title: Ivorian payroll, right the first time
hero.lead: NexusRH CI runs your payroll and HR under Ivorian law: CNPS, ITS, Labour Code, FDFP, DISA. Not a foreign product bent into shape — a system written for Côte d'Ivoire.

video.label: Overview
video.caption: The product in motion: payroll, employee records, leave, hiring, reporting.
video.unsupported: Your browser cannot play this video.

proof.title: The two CNPS ceilings
proof.lead: CNPS applies two different ceilings depending on the branch. A generic payroll engine knows only one, and gets it wrong as soon as a salary passes 70,000 FCFA — which is nearly always.
proof.note: The same 2,000,000 FCFA produce three different calculation bases. NexusRH CI applies the right one on every line, and the payslip is in whole FCFA — never cents.

audience.title: Companies that have to account for themselves

sme.title: Ivorian SMEs and mid-caps
sme.text: From ten to several thousand employees, with an HR team that has no time to check every rate by hand.

group.title: Groups and subsidiaries
group.text: Several companies, several countries, one system. Each subsidiary keeps its own rules; management sees the whole.

public.title: Public sector and NGOs
public.text: Full traceability of decisions and payments, with data hosted in Côte d'Ivoire if you require it.

agency.title: HR and accounting firms
agency.text: One firm handles several client companies from a single account, without ever mixing their data.

compliance.title: Ivorian law in the engine, not in a settings screen
compliance.lead: These rules are not options to configure: they are written into the calculation, tested, and updated as the law changes.

cnps.title: CNPS 2024
cnps.text: Two ceilings for retirement and accident/family/maternity, rates per branch, work-accident rate by sector — trade, construction, industry, extraction.

its.title: ITS and DGI
its.text: The 15% allowance applied before the brackets, employee contributions deducted, monthly brackets, tax credits by family situation.

labour.title: Labour Code
labour.text: Leave counted in working days with seniority bonuses, Ivorian public holidays, overtime premiums, notice periods, maternity, paternity, bereavement.

declarations.title: Filings
declarations.text: Monthly CNPS filing, annual DISA generated in January from the year's twelve payslips, FDFP contribution, staff register.

ohada.title: OHADA contracts
ohada.text: Permanent, fixed-term, probation, internship, apprenticeship: compliant templates, amendments, terminations and final settlement.

currency.title: FCFA without cents
currency.text: Every amount is a whole number, from the payslip to the bank transfer. No rounding slips in between the calculation and the payment.

modules.title: The whole employee life cycle
modules.lead: Each module is switched on or off per company. You do not pay for what you do not use, and the interface only shows what concerns you.

payroll.title: Payroll and filings
payroll.items: Ivorian payroll engine · Payslips built from blocks · Variable items · Period closing · CNPS filings · Annual DISA · FDFP · Staff register · Export to SAGE

people.title: Employee records
people.items: Employee files · OHADA contracts and amendments · Documents and photos · Departments and sites · Org chart · Disciplinary record · Offboarding and final settlement

time.title: Time and leave
time.items: Leave in working days · Sickness, maternity, paternity · Balances computed automatically · Approval flow · Time clocks · Overtime

talent.title: Talent and careers
talent.items: Job and skills framework · Reviews · Nine-box calibration · Succession plans · Internal mobility · Training and sessions · Anonymous engagement surveys

hiring.title: Hiring
hiring.items: APEC-format job posts · Public careers page · Applications and automatic screening · Assisted sourcing · Interview practice · Onboarding

steering.title: Reporting and administration
steering.items: Dashboards per role · 360° executive view · Reports and exports · Expense claims · Company settings · Audit log · API and connectors

pay.title: From payslip to employee, with no re-keying
pay.lead: Payroll does not stop at the calculation. NexusRH CI produces the payment itself, in both forms used in Côte d'Ivoire.

mobile.title: Mobile Money
mobile.text: Wave, MTN and Orange, directly or through the CinetPay aggregator. Numbers validated in Ivorian format, every payment tracked until confirmation.

bank.title: Bank transfer
bank.text: One file per bank, in the format your bank expects. The format is described once, from a sample file, then reused every month — and sent to the bank from your own address.

multi.title: Several companies, several countries
multi.lead: An Ivorian group expanding across UEMOA or CEMAC keeps a single system. Each country applies its own law; consolidation stays possible.

entities.title: Subsidiaries
entities.text: Each company has its own employees, payroll and filings. Site managers only see their own scope.

packs.title: Country packs
packs.text: Six ready-made UEMOA and CEMAC rule sets, each with its own contributions and brackets.

consolidation.title: Consolidation
consolidation.text: Executives see payroll cost, headcount and indicators across the group, without reaching individual records.

ai.title: AI where it actually saves time
ai.lead: No AI for show. Three precise uses, and you stay in control of each one.

assistant.title: HR assistant
assistant.text: It answers on your own data — a leave balance, a calculation rule, a headcount — within the rights of whoever is asking.

screening.title: Application screening
screening.text: You define the knock-out criteria. The AI ranks and summarises; it never rejects on grounds you did not set.

interview.title: Interview practice
interview.text: Candidates and employees practise privately. Answers are neither scored by the recruiter nor kept beyond the stated retention period.

control.title: Your key, your model
control.text: Plug in your own key and pick the model. Otherwise the platform provides the service, and your usage stays visible.

security.title: Payroll data is the most sensitive data a company holds
security.lead: Salaries, CNPS numbers, bank details: a leak cannot be taken back. Here is what protects them.

isolation.title: Isolation per company
isolation.text: Each company gets its own database schema. This is not an application-level filter: two clients' data never share the same tables.

rbac.title: Seven roles, strict rights
rbac.text: A manager sees their team, an employee sees their own file, a site manager sees their scope. Rights are enforced on the server, not just in the display.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.text: Can be required for every account, with backup codes. Lockout after repeated failures, password expiry, and refusal of passwords found in known breaches.

crypto.title: Sensitive data encrypted
crypto.text: Identification numbers, bank details and connection secrets are encrypted at rest. All traffic goes over HTTPS.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.text: Who viewed, changed, approved, exported — and when. Required by Ivorian cybercrime law, and what makes an inspection straightforward.

hosting.title: Sovereign hosting
hosting.text: Public bodies and banks may require files to stay in Côte d'Ivoire. Storage then switches to local infrastructure.

sso.title: SSO and monitoring
sso.text: Federated sign-in through OIDC, SAML or LDAP with your directory, and security events exported to your SIEM.

signature.title: Electronic signature
signature.text: Contracts and documents signed in the application, with a signer flow and time-stamped proof of consent.
